default.title: Scoped activity history and complete CRM relationships
default.summary: ClawPilot now provides project-independent activity history, complete organization and contact editing, reliable SuiteCRM relationship projections, and explicit tenant-safe administrator controls.
features: One Activity drawer for account, project, pipeline, CRM, agent, integration, and release events regardless of the selected board
My activity, organization-subtree, and global-system scopes controlled by explicit administrator permissions
Successful and failed sign-ins, magic-code requests, sign-outs, user access changes, sharing changes, and task history in the durable audit stream
Editable CRM metadata and related-contact subpanels for organizations and contacts
Owner-controlled local or external document embeddings with local processing as the default
fixes: Snapshots organization scope when each audit event is written so later membership or sharing changes do not rewrite history
Excludes tenant records and tenant resource discovery from the global-system activity scope
Redacts secrets, credentials, raw network addresses, cookies, and authentication codes from activity responses
Backfills SuiteCRM Note relationships so interactions appear under their related Contacts as well as Accounts
Retires the two rejected interaction identifiers without allowing either Global ID to be reused
Preserves Nick's Organization and Nick's approved global administrator access while retaining child-organization data scope
Adds Needs Review discovery for incomplete CRM records and consolidates current operational documentation
